task: User-requested solver abstraction and composable constraint builder
kind: Engine development with behavior-preserving default encoding refactor

layout.src/instance.hpp: Solver-independent binary PB builder, indexed A/cross variables, graph context, auxiliary allocation, weighted >= constraints and read-only row views
layout.src/instance.cpp: Canonical variable numbering, input/reference validation and flat numeric model storage
layout.src/core.cpp: Eight exact Ramsey constraint families as add_core_constraints(InstanceBuilder &)
layout.src/opb.cpp: OPB serialization only, final model-derived header counts, dynamic variable-token cache and bounded output buffering
layout.src/engine.cpp: Explicit construct / add core / add future components / serialize composition point

contracts: All variables are binary; A edge IDs are lexicographic and cross IDs row-major
A/cross indices are zero-based; A edge lookup accepts either orientation and rejects loops
Auxiliary allocation is monotonic and does not renumber existing variables
add_ge copies terms, accepts signed int coefficients and int64 RHS, and rejects unallocated variable references
Components may allocate variables before or after other components and need not precompute counts
Repeated variables and empty constant constraints are retained; row views may be copied back into the builder
No solver-specific strings or OPB formatting in Ramsey constraint generation
No new mathematical cuts enabled by default

tradeoff.description: Numeric constraints are buffered in contiguous vectors rather than streamed directly; this enables arbitrary component additions before writing an exact header without replaying generation or spooling text

build_and_cpp.result: 1/1 CTest passes, including 5104 exhaustive rooted assignments, exhaustive composed auxiliary constraints, wide rows beyond 1000 variables, reused row views and impossible empty constraints

default_opb_parity.method: Generate catalogue entries 1 and 2 using --generate-only before and after the change; cmp both complete outputs
default_opb_parity.result: Both byte-identical, including comments, headers, variable numbering and row order

external_component_smoke.method: Throwaway external consumer builds the full first catalogue core, invokes a separate function allocating an auxiliary binary and two inequalities, then writes OPB
external_component_smoke.scope: API exercise only; the example inequalities are not asserted to be valid Ramsey cuts
